newsitem.title: UK: Berisford suitor gets cold feet-paper.
newsitem.headline: Berisford suitor gets cold feet-paper.

text.p: British consumer food equipment to home-improvement group Berisford International Plc is expected to announce on Monday that a potential bid approach for the company has ended inconclusively, the Times newspaper said.
Shares in the company, which owns the Magnet do-it-yourself chain, rose sharply last month after it disclosed it had received a takeover approach.
Although no company was named, Swedish consumer good manufacturer AB Electrolux was said by analysts to have been a likely suitor, given its estimated cash reserves of more than 600 million stg.
